Name: Cottage Core Walls and Floors AT
Author: DatGrayFox
Description:
Cute wallpapers with trims that match the wood tones of the "Aimon's Fancy Farmhouse" mod, with additional stone trims and the option for no trim. As well as various trim matching wood floorings, tile, and stone floorings.

The wallpapers include:
- 7 wallpapers in pink, green, yellow, and black with little to medium patterning for a less busy design. 
- 2 stone-type wallpapers (dark and light) with optional vines.
- 2 hyper-detailed wallpapers. One with bees, dandelions, and mushrooms. The other is with snails, various mushrooms, and vines.
- 3 cute wallpapers. One with frogs along the bottom on a blank light green background. Another with strawberries along the top above a vine heart on a lightly striped pink background. The last is with foxes on the bottom, and acorns lining the top, all on a cream background.
-1 delicate wallpaper, with a lace-like pattern towards the top, trim matching moths just below that, and mushrooms between the moths.
-5 tile wallpaper in black, gray, cream, pink, and green.

The floors include: 
- Vertical and horizontal large planks. (All wood tones)
- Vertical and horizontal small planks. (All wood tones)
- Left and right diagonal planks. (All wood tones)
- Diamond-shaped tile in black, gray, cream, pink and green.
- Diagonal and vertical tile in black, gray, cream, pink and green.
- Square-shaped tile in black, gray, cream, pink and green.
- Diagonal and vertical stone tile, dark and light.
- Carpet in, black, gray, cream, pink, orange, yellow, dark green, and light green.
